name: Mashike (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Mashike town emblem in white: a broken ring with four spokes enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mashike, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 13 June 1972.

features.role: Mashike town emblem — a broken ring with four spokes enclosing a stylised character
